title: 5100011: prove the arbitrary-point pedal-area product k203,a
body:
The proof establishes the full k203,a source target: for every fixed real pedal point M and every primitive elliptic-billiard period divisible by four, the signed product A·A_M is constant, including star orbits.

The key relation is A_M=c_M·A_inner, derived from the radial dependence on M, cancellation of meromorphic double poles, and a two-simple-pole uniqueness argument. Chavez-Caliz’s published even-period area-product theorem and the explicitly proved polarity map then complete the product. Stachel’s canonical parametrization, DLMF identities, classical complex methods, and the shared central-pedal author contribution from target5100012 are all credited. This is not a novelty claim.

The unchanged frozen proof passed a separate full adversarial review by an uninvolved reviewer. All21,419 author exact controls and2,691 separately labeled numerical diagnostics pass. Independent19,039 exact controls and1,539 numerical diagnostics also pass. The general proof, rather than finite diagnostics, supplies the all-period conclusion.

Only this target’s QUEUE.md row changes, to claimed_solved2/5. The initial unreviewed checkpoint is preserved in commit history, and all six independent-review artifacts are included unchanged. Scope is signed traversal area, arbitrary fixed M, least period0mod4, nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic; no hyperbolic or repeated-odd-period extension is asserted.
